title: Token Cost Optimizer — Strategic Notes & Mini-Workbook
content:
Purpose:
A compact, action-oriented mini-workbook to help the Hosted API pricing and infra teams identify 6–12 week wins to reduce per-token COGS while preserving customer-facing latency and quality. This is intended as a working spreadsheet + recommendations digest for leadership and SRE/Serving to pilot optimizations per region and model family.

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Shortlist: prioritize batching + KV cache in US regions for high-throughput chat flows, region-specific model routing for low-volume EU customers, and an int8 quantization pilot for 7B family.
- Expected impact (conservative): 12–18% reduction in blended per-token COGS within 8 weeks if all pilots hit targets.
- Key constraints: latency SLOs for < 300ms p95 in premium tier, enterprise compliance for Private/Dedicated customers (no routing to APAC for some accounts).

Mini-workbook (text spreadsheet):
Sheet: assumptions
- Baseline GPU cost (amortized infra + ops) per GPU-hr: us-west: $2.40, eu-central: $2.85, asia-east: $3.10
- Average tokens/sec sustained per GPU (chat style, with current runtime): 350 tokens/sec for 7B quantized-like path, 90 tokens/sec for 70B, 220 for 13B.
- Request mix (hosted-api): chat_stream: 62%, single_completion: 28%, embeddings/rerank: 10%

Sheet: per-1k token COGS (blended by model and region) [values are illustrative and include infra + networking + orchestration overhead]:
- model=7B, region=us-west => 0.21 USD per 1k tokens
- model=7B, region=eu-central => 0.25 USD per 1k tokens
- model=7B, region=asia-east => 0.29 USD per 1k tokens
- model=13B, region=us-west => 0.47 USD per 1k tokens
- model=13B, region=eu-central => 0.53 USD per 1k tokens
- model=13B, region=asia-east => 0.61 USD per 1k tokens
- model=70B, region=us-west => 1.45 USD per 1k tokens
- model=70B, region=eu-central => 1.67 USD per 1k tokens
- model=70B, region=asia-east => 1.89 USD per 1k tokens

Sheet: margin sensitivity (two sample price points):
- Price charged (hosted API) = $0.45 per 1k for 7B => margin = 0.45 - 0.21 = 0.24 (53% margin) in us-west
- Price charged = $0.45 per 1k for 7B in eu-central => margin = 0.45 - 0.25 = 0.20 (44% margin)
- If price dropped to $0.35 per 1k, margin in us-west becomes 0.14 (40% margin).

Optimization hypotheses and estimated impact (conservative / friction notes):
1) Autoscaler & continuous-batching tuning (priority high)
   - What: tune max-batch-delay (ms) per route, prefer larger batch windows for non-interactive completion flows; enable burst pooling for chat_stream when concurrency spike detected.
   - Why: increases GPU utilization and tokens/sec per GPU without infra changes.
   - Impact estimate: 6–9% COGS reduction for affected routes (chat_stream heavy customers).
   - Risk: increases tail latency if misconfigured. Can be mitigated with per-route batch caps and canary.

2) Prefix/KV caching for multi-turn chat (priority high for retained sessions)
   - What: persist KV cache across short-lived containers for returning sessions; TTL heuristics by session age and user-tier.
   - Impact estimate: 4–7% blended COGS reduction for customers with heavy multi-turn sessions.
   - Implementation note: requires small runtime API change + cache warmup metrics and eviction policy.

3) Region-aware routing by effective price (priority medium)
   - What: route non-mandated enterprise requests to lowest-cost compatible region (respecting legal constraints).
   - Impact: up to 10% blended cost improvement for customers with flexible latency tolerance.
   - Operational asks: add per-customer constraints page in Console and a routing fallback view.

4) Model family downgrade recommendations (safety net)
   - What: for exploratory or low-trust workloads, recommend 7B family with prompt templates and response validation instead of 13B or 70B.
   - Impact: up to 20–35% token-level cost savings per request moved.
   - Note: requires UX flows, and quality guardrails (evals + A/B testing).

5) Quantization pilot: int8 for <13B (priority medium)
   - What: run a controlled quantization conversion for 7B/13B, evaluate output degradation and throughput improvement.
   - Impact: 8–15% throughput improvement -> equivalent COGS reduction if latency SLOs hold.
   - Risk: subtle quality regressions for some prompt classes; must tie to eval suite.

Short checklist / runbook for 8-week pilot:
- Week 0: finalize metric dashboard (per-model-region COGS, p95 latency by route, session KV hit rate) — owner: Ravi Kumar — due: 2026-03-17
- Week 1–2: enable per-route batching experiments in us-west (canary on 10% traffic) — owner: Maya Li — due: 2026-03-31
- Week 2–4: KV cache persistence rollout for chat_stream on selected customers — owner: Elena Gomez — due: 2026-04-14
- Week 3–6: quantization MLP run + eval suite for 7B — owner: Mali Ops (infra) — due: 2026-04-28
- Week 5–8: region-routing pilot for low-latency-tolerant customers + Console flag UI — owner: Product Ops — due: 2026-05-12

Sample formula notes (for product spreadsheet cells):
- blended_cogs_by_region = sum( model_volume_fraction * cogs_model_region ) over models
- per_1k_cost = (gpu_hour_cost / tokens_per_hour) * 1000 + orchestration_overhead_per_1k + egress_per_1k
- margin_pct = (price_per_1k - per_1k_cost) / price_per_1k

Open questions / unknowns to resolve (for next meeting):
- Precise tokens/sec for our current serving runtime on new 8-bit kernels (ask serving-runtime bench team).
- Egress costs by region for typical multi-turn chat sessions (network team).
- Customer-specific routing constraints (GTM/legal).

Recommended quick experiments (A/B friendly):
- A: Increase batch window by 10ms on completion-only routes and measure delta in tokens/sec and p95 latency.
- B: Serve 5% of returning-chat sessions with KV cache warm-start to measure token savings and user-visible latency change.
- C: Side-by-side eval of int8 vs bfloat16 for 7B on 50 curated prompts (quality delta tracking).

Appendix: suggested dashboard KPIs to add to Console/Optimize page:
- per-model-per-region COGS (USD per 1k tokens) — trend + 7d moving avg
- p95 latency by route tier (free, standard, premium)
- KV cache hit rate and tokens avoided per day
- batching average batch size and max delay
- number of routed requests moved cross-region and estimated savings

Contact / next steps:
- Sync: 30-min sync with serving-runtime + infra + product-optimize next Tue to prioritize pilot owners and infra tickets.
- If prioritized, convert the key workbook cells into a shared Google Sheet and link to Console mockups.

Notes to self (raw):
- keep price elasticities conservative (customers will push back on quality changes)
- coordinate with sales/solutions for enterprise accounts that prohibit cross-region moves
- ensure telemetry tags for any canary changes so rollbacks are quick

End of file.
